snippet.title: Neon Inferno - Official Demo Launch Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Get another look at Neon Inferno in this latest trailer for the upcoming hybrid side-scroller and gallery-shooter game where the action takes place in both the foreground and the background. As warring factions battle for control of a dystopian New York City, you enter the fray as an assassin for the Family -- a notorious crime syndicate determined to eliminate its rivals and dominate the metropolitan battlefield. Neon Inferno will be available on October 2 for PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch with a demo available now.
